title: perf-benchmarking-sync-2026-03-10
content:
Performance & Benchmarking Sync - 2026-03-10

Attendees:
- Aisha Patel (owner)
- Miguel Santos
- Chen Liu
- Ravi Kapoor
- Sara Nguyen
- Daniel K. (joined late)

Agenda:
1) Review regression observed in nightly benchmark run (2026-03-09)
2) Summarize test runs + env details
3) Hypotheses for root cause
4) Action items and short-term mitigations

Summary / TL;DR:
- Nightly run on master (job: nightly-perf-2026-03-09) shows a latency and throughput regression for short-sequence workloads after merging PR #4321.
- Impact: p50 latency for seq=128 increased from ~42ms -> ~58ms (~38% increase). p95 increased from ~120ms -> ~210ms. Token throughput decreased ~25% (12k -> 9k tokens/s) on A100-40GB test cluster.
- Suspected causes: fallback to new kernel selection path in PR #4321 that adds extra kernel launch overhead for short sequences; and a separate kv-cache invalidation path that may be introducing extra memcpy for batched requests.

Observed metrics (nightly-perf-2026-03-09):
- Model: redwood-7b-4bit-qat (quantized, QAT 4-bit profile)
- Hardware: A100-40GB (single GPU), CUDA 12.1, cuBLAS/cuDNN latest validated kernels
- Batch sizes: 1, 4, 8 (we looked at 1 and 4 primarily)
- Seq lengths sampled: 16/32/64/128/512 (workload weighted to 32/128)
- Baseline (2026-03-03 master): p50(seq=128, batch=1) = 42ms, p95 = 120ms, throughput = 12.0k tokens/s
- Current (2026-03-09 master): p50(seq=128, batch=1) = 58ms, p95 = 210ms, throughput = 9.0k tokens/s
- Observations: largest regressions at seq<=128 and small batch sizes. Long sequences (>=512) show negligible change.

Test run details / commands:
- Jenkins job: nightly-perf-2026-03-09 (artifact tarball: s3://redwood-perf/nightly/2026-03-09/)
- Perf harness: ./perf_harness --model redwood-7b-4bit --batch 1,4 --seq 16,32,64,128,512 --num-steps 2000 --device cuda:0
- Docker image: redwood/serving-runtime:nightly-2026-03-09 (contains PR #4321 merged)
- Comparison run used image redwood/serving-runtime:baseline-2026-03-03

Hypotheses discussed:
1) Kernel selection logic (PR #4321): new logic prefers "unified" kernel path that does extra setup per-request; causes extra per-call latency for short sequences. Miguel to bisect within PR to identify exact commit/hunk that introduced overhead.
2) KV-cache invalidation path: Chen observed increased memory copy counts in profiling (nvprof traces) for batched requests when KV cache is hit; possible double-copy when combining prefix cache + batching.
3) Scheduling change in runtime thread pool: Ravi noted a change in how the IO/compute threads are pinned; could introduce context switch overhead for low-latency requests.
4) Quantization changes unlikely: no new quantization code merged since baseline, but QAT runtime handshake changed in #4321; still lower probability.

Immediate repro + debug plan:
- Reproduce locally on devbox (Aisha / Miguel): run perf_harness with timeline traces and nvprof to capture kernel launch times and memcpy counts. Target: reproduce p50 delta within 10% of nightly. (Owner: Miguel, due: 2026-03-11)
- Bisect PR #4321 to isolate the exact change: create a quick bisect branch and run 4 shorter perf runs to narrow down. (Owner: Miguel + Chen, due: 2026-03-12)
- Add additional microbenchmarks for kernel-launch overhead: single-step single-seq runs with high resolution timers. (Owner: Ravi, due: 2026-03-12)
- Check thread-pinning configs across images (baseline vs nightly) and run a test toggling affinity to see impact. (Owner: Sara, due: 2026-03-12)

Short-term mitigation options discussed:
- Rollback PR #4321 temporarily if bisect confirms the regression and we cannot patch quickly. (Owner: Aisha / Release Eng, decision target: 2026-03-13)
- Add a targeted fast-path for short sequences that bypasses the new unified kernel path (engineering cost: medium). (Owner: Miguel, proposal due: 2026-03-14)
- Increase autoscaling buffer on Dedicated test cluster to mask throughput drop while we investigate (ops mitigation). (Owner: Ravi, ops ticket INF-987 created)

Follow-ups and action items (summary):
- Miguel: Bisect PR #4321 + reproduce locally with nvprof and perf_harness (due 2026-03-12).
- Chen: Investigate KV-cache memcpy path and add instrumentation to count copies per request (due 2026-03-12).
- Ravi: Microbench for thread-pinning and kernel-launch timers (due 2026-03-12).
- Sara: Validate Docker images and runtime config diffs between baseline and nightly (due 2026-03-12).
- Aisha: Coordinate rollback plan and communicate to product/CS if we need to revert (due 2026-03-13).

Notes to self / meeting fragments captured:
- "If bisect points at kernel selection, we should add a perf test to CI that runs a 2k-step short-seq pass to catch this class of regression."
- "Consider adding p50/p95 delta alerts on the Grafana dashboard for short-seq workloads (seq<=128)."
- "We need a checklist in PR template for any change touching kernel selection or KV cache paths to run quick perf harness locally."

Links referenced in meeting:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/4321
- Jira INF-987 (ops ticket for temporary capacity bump): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-987
- Daily perf dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-internal.com/d/serving/runtime-perf?orgId=1

Next sync: 2026-03-12 10:00 PT (30m) — focused on bisect results and repro status.

End of notes.
